title: The Eschatological Discourse on the Mount of Olives
description: On the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Jesus predicts that not one stone will be left upon another. To Peter, James, John, and Andrew, he speaks of wars, earthquakes, persecution, the abomination of desolation, and the great tribulation. He warns against false messiahs and prophets, and foretells that the Son of Man will come in clouds with great power and glory to gather his elect. Jesus concludes with the parable of the fig tree and urges vigilance, since no one knows the day or the hour.
